pages.title: Entangled Relay
pages.text: Two halves of a quantum pair, each locked inside a small housing. Whatever happens to one is correlated with the other, however far apart they sit. It is cold, quiet and faintly luminous at the junctions.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Entanglement cannot send messages faster than light on its own, but it does make two places share a state. Binding Entangled Photon Pairs with a quantum dot and a chronon capacitor gave me linked relays.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Chronodynamics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Entangled Transceiver.
